title.zh: 【币安：已覆盖黑客攻击事件损失中的 60 亿美元】
title.en: 【币安：已覆盖黑客攻击事件损失中的 60 亿美元】

current_state.zh: Binance announced via X that it has covered $6 billion of the losses stemming from a hacking incident, a claim implying one of the largest exchange-funded security losses on record.
